practices.practice: Create one long-lived MongoClient per process and reuse it (do not create a new MongoClient per request).
practices.prior_belief: Read the DocumentDB/Mongo connection string from an environment variable (DOCUMENTDB_URI) at process start and create a single long-lived PyMongo MongoClient for the whole app; do not create a new MongoClient per request.
practices.source_name: documentdb-driver

practices.practice: Always connect with TLS (tls=true) and verify server certificates; keep connection strings out of source control and only in environment or secure stores.
practices.prior_belief: Require TLS/SSL for the MongoDB connection (tls=true), verify server certificates (disable tlsAllowInvalidCertificates), and do not embed the connection string in source control or logs; keep it only in environment or secure config stores.
practices.source_name: Quickstart: Use Azure DocumentDB with MongoDB driver for Python
practices.how_found: "Azure DocumentDB MongoDB connection string TLS SCRAM-SHA-256 mongodb+srv tls=true"

practices.practice: Tune MongoClient pool and timeout options (maxPoolSize, minPoolSize, maxIdleTimeMS, connectTimeoutMS, socketTimeoutMS) appropriate to your deployment (serverless vs long-running) and reuse the pool across workers.
practices.prior_belief: Use connection-pool tuning options on MongoClient (e.g., maxPoolSize, minPoolSize, serverSelectionTimeoutMS) appropriate for the app concurrency and reuse the pool for async/fastapi workers to avoid connection storms.
practices.source_name: documentdb-connection

practices.practice: Store credentials and keys in a secrets manager or environment variables (e.g., Key Vault / managed identities); never commit DOCUMENTDB_URI or API keys to the repository.
practices.prior_belief: Store credentials and keys in a secrets manager (Key Vault) or environment variables; never commit DOCUMENTDB_URI or OPENAI_API_KEY to repository; provide only a .env.example with placeholders in the repo.
practices.source_name: documentdb-security

practices.practice: Use least-privilege database users or Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) RBAC for applications instead of cluster admin/root credentials.
practices.prior_belief: Use least privilege database users/roles for the app (create a Mongo user restricted to the sample_banking_01 database and only the operations needed), rather than a cluster admin/root credential.
practices.source_name: security-entra-rbac (documentdb-security)

practices.practice: Index all fields used to join or traverse graphs (e.g., from_account/to_account, transaction_id, timestamp) and create compound indexes for common filter + sort patterns.
practices.prior_belief: Index all fields used to join or traverse graphs (e.g., sender_account_id, receiver_account_id, transaction_id, timestamp) and create compound indexes for common filter + sort patterns (e.g., {account_id:1, timestamp:-1}).
practices.source_name: documentdb-indexing

practices.practice: When doing recursive/graph traversals (e.g., $graphLookup), limit recursion depth and apply restrictive match filters so the engine can push filters to indexes and avoid unbounded scans.
practices.prior_belief: When using $graphLookup, limit depth and use restrictSearchWithMatch to bound the search early; ensure the fields used by $graphLookup are indexed to avoid collection scans.
practices.source_name: Azure DocumentDB release notes / compatibility pages

practices.practice: Put $match stages as early as possible in aggregation pipelines to reduce the working set, and use allowDiskUse=true for very large aggregations that exceed memory.
practices.prior_belief: Put $match stages as early as possible in aggregation pipelines to reduce working set and improve pipeline performance; use allowDiskUse=True for large aggregations.
practices.source_name: Read query explain output in Azure DocumentDB

practices.practice: Use explain('executionStats') on representative find and aggregate operations and inspect index usage, totalDocsExamined vs nReturned, and plan stages to detect COLLSCANs and inefficiencies.
practices.prior_belief: Use explain() on representative aggregation pipelines and $graphLookup queries and inspect index usage and stage-by-stage document counts to validate index effectiveness and detect unexpected COLLSCANs.
practices.source_name: Read query explain output in Azure DocumentDB

practices.practice: Treat 429 (throttling) and transient network errors as transient: honor Retry‑After / retry-after-ms headers and retry with exponential backoff and jitter to avoid throttling loops.
practices.prior_belief: Implement transient-fault handling: treat 429 (throughput exceeded) and network errors as transient, retry with exponential backoff, and honor Retry-After when present to avoid throttling loops.
practices.source_name: Optimize provisioned throughput cost in Azure Cosmos DB / Throttling guidance

practices.practice: Avoid running long-running synchronous analysis inside request/response handlers; run heavy aggregations or graph jobs as background tasks or batch jobs and return job IDs for async processing.
practices.prior_belief: Avoid long-running synchronous analysis in request/response handlers (FastAPI endpoints); run heavy aggregation/graph jobs as background tasks or batch jobs and return job ids so UI/API remains responsive.
practices.source_name: Best practices for background jobs (Azure Architecture)

practices.practice: Don't assume multi-document transactions span collections or shards; verify support for the Mongo-compatible API/version and prefer idempotent writes or application-level compensation where possible.
practices.prior_belief: Do not rely on multi-document transactions for correctness-critical flows unless you have validated that the Mongo-compatible API and cluster version fully support them; prefer idempotent writes and application-level compensation where possible.
practices.source_name: Aggregation pipeline examples and limitations / feature tables

practices.practice: Design the data model to support graph queries: keep transaction references in top-level fields optimized for $graphLookup and denormalize or precompute attributes used frequently by analysis.
practices.prior_belief: Design data model to support graph queries used by AML detection: keep transaction references (counterparty ids / transaction refs) in fields optimized for $graphLookup, and include precomputed denormalized fields if queries are frequent.
practices.source_name: documentdb-data-modeling

practices.practice: Limit the size of returned documents with projection ($project) to reduce network and memory overhead during aggregations and narrative construction.
practices.prior_belief: Limit the size of returned documents via projection (only requested fields) in aggregations and queries to reduce network and memory overhead when building narratives.
practices.source_name: Full-text search and aggregation examples / aggregate operator docs
practices.how_found: "projection reduce network memory Azure DocumentDB aggregation"

practices.practice: When bulk-loading, use bulk_write / bulk insert with appropriate batch sizes and unordered mode, and create indexes after the bulk load when possible to speed ingestion.
practices.prior_belief: When seeding or bulk-loading documents, use bulk_write/bulk inserts with appropriate batch sizes and unordered mode for speed, and create indexes after bulk load when possible to speed ingestion.
practices.source_name: Indexing Best Practices in Azure DocumentDB
practices.how_found: "create indexes after bulk load Azure DocumentDB"

practices.practice: Avoid excessive or redundant indexes; each additional index increases write cost—monitor index usage via $indexStats and drop indexes with low usage.
practices.prior_belief: Avoid excessive or redundant indexes; each index increases write latency and RU consumption—monitor index usage and drop indexes with low usage.
practices.source_name: documentdb-indexing

practices.practice: For vector-enabled collections choose the index algorithm by scale (IVF/HNSW/DiskANN), and tune parameters (numLists, efConstruction, M, lBuild, lSearch, maxDegree, product quantization / fp16) to balance recall and latency; normalize embeddings for cosine similarity.
practices.prior_belief: For vector-enabled collections, create appropriate vector indexes (e.g., HNSW/IVF/DiskANN) on embedding fields with suitable parameters (efConstruction, M, metric) matched to query latency/recall needs; verify supported index options for the DocumentDB variant before applying them.
practices.source_name: Integrated vector store in Azure DocumentDB
practices.how_found: "Azure DocumentDB vector index HNSW IVF DiskANN efConstruction lSearch"

practices.practice: Detect/redact or pseudonymize PII before sending data to external LLM/embedding services and use Azure PII-detection/redaction features or enterprise Azure OpenAI privacy controls when possible.
practices.prior_belief: Scrub or pseudonymize PII before sending to external LLM/embedding services (or require an explicit opt-in); if using OPENAI_API_KEY, do not send raw account IDs or transaction details unless policy permits.
practices.source_name: Transparency note for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) / Azure OpenAI data privacy
practices.how_found: "PII redact Azure OpenAI DocumentDB send PII to LLM"

practices.practice: Enable diagnostic settings and collect metrics/alerts for RU consumption, CPU, memory, IOPS, storage, and slow-query logs; analyze them in Log Analytics and alert on saturation.
practices.prior_belief: Enable and collect database diagnostics: RU consumption, latency percentiles, index metrics, and slow queries; integrate with app logging/metrics and set alerts for elevated RU or 429 rates.
practices.source_name: documentdb-monitoring

practices.practice: Mask or redact sensitive fields in application logs and exported narratives (e.g., partially mask account IDs) and enforce role-based access to investigative artifacts.
practices.prior_belief: Mask or redact sensitive fields in application logs and structured narratives (e.g., partial account numbers) and store only the minimum data needed for investigation; enforce role-based access for exported narratives.
practices.source_name: documentdb-security

practices.practice: Add a schemaVersion field to documents and migrate lazily so analysis and migration code can evolve safely.
practices.prior_belief: Add a schemaVersion field to accounts/transactions documents so analysis code and migration scripts can evolve without misinterpreting older documents.
practices.source_name: documentdb-data-modeling

practices.practice: Use explain() plus indexStats and collection stats (or the MCP/explorer tools) to validate indexes and query plans; if portal/index-creation fails, create indexes asynchronously or with background:true via drivers.
practices.prior_belief: Use database-side explain and server index statistics (indexStats, collStats) and the DocumentDB MCP/explorer to validate any index creation commands; if an index creation via the MCP tool fails, create indexes via PyMongo with background:true to avoid blocking.
practices.source_name: Manage indexing in Azure DocumentDB / Indexing Best Practices

practices.practice: When materializing recursive/$graphLookup results, paginate or limit returned chain lengths and project only the attributes required to build the narrative to bound memory and RU use.
practices.prior_belief: Be conservative with projection of entire subdocuments during $graphLookup results: paginate or limit returned chain lengths and materialize only the attributes required to build the suspicious-activity narrative.
practices.source_name: documentdb-query-optimizer

practices.practice: Implement client-side rate limiting and batching when performing many lookups or embedding requests to avoid bursts that trigger throttling or RU spikes.
practices.prior_belief: Implement client-side rate limiting and batching when the agent performs many lookups/embeddings to avoid burst traffic that causes throttling or spikes in RU consumption.
practices.source_name: Optimize provisioned throughput cost in Azure Cosmos DB / vector search tips

practices.practice: Harden network and encryption: use Private Endpoints / firewall rules and, for regulated workloads, use customer-managed keys (CMK) for encryption at rest.
practices.source_name: documentdb-security

practices.practice: Use Index Advisor and the service's index recommendation tools to analyze slow queries and get prioritized index suggestions before applying changes.
practices.source_name: Tune query performance with Index Advisor in Azure DocumentDB (preview)

practices.practice: When combining vector and structured filters, pre-filter candidates (pre_filter) to narrow the vector search input and preserve top-k recall rather than post-filtering results.
practices.source_name: Use LangChain on Azure with Azure DocumentDB / Vector search docs
